title: Teladoc Health unveils new AI capabilities within Solo platform for hospitals
source_used: Healthcare Dive (pool item is Fierce Healthcare, blocked here)
key_facts: Teladoc Health is adding SoloVitals and SoloScribe to its Solo virtual care platform for hospitals and health systems, it announced on Wednesday 7 Oct 2026.

SoloVitals lets care teams track patients' heart and respiratory rates without touching them, using a camera and changes in skin colour; only select customers can use it in private preview, with broad release expected in December.
SoloScribe is an ambient AI documentation feature that records and transcribes in-person and virtual visits to create clinical notes; it is now available.
Teladoc says integrating features into one platform is a significant benefit for health systems, and Healthcare Dive says integration would also benefit the vendor.
Teladoc posted a net loss of $200.3 million in 2025 and lowered its 2026 revenue outlook in July, to $2.36 billion to $2.45 billion, mainly because of its BetterHelp mental health division.
quote_evidence: Telehealth company Teladoc Health is adding new artificial intelligence capabilities to its virtual care platform for hospitals and health systems, it announced Wednesday.
While integration could reduce point-solution fatigue, it would also benefit the digital health vendor.
why_it_matters_hint: Hospital virtual-care tools with AI note-writing and camera-based vitals; the company's own launch, with the vitals feature in limited preview.
